applicability_conditions: Deceased must match the life insured on the policy
Policy must be in force at the event date
Death benefit must be applicable per policy terms

required_documents.label: Cancelled cheque / bank passbook for NEFT
Assignment/endorsement documents if policy was assigned

conditional_documents.label: Medical records/hospital papers if death due to illness
conditional_documents.condition: If death occurred during hospitalisation or within policy-specific period

conditional_documents.label: Post-mortem report / FIR if accidental death
conditional_documents.condition: If death is accidental or unnatural

conditional_documents.label: Legal guardian certificate if nominee is minor
conditional_documents.condition: If registered nominee is a minor
